name: Runner Extras - CRM Proxy Version
brief: Proves the runner registers the Xrm proxy versions BC's service tier registers at startup.
description: Issue #3515. BaseApp's CRM/CDS Connection Setup pages call GetLastProxyVersionItem, which fills a TempStack record from the DotNet CrmHelper.GetProxyIdList() and then FindLasts it. GetProxyIdList returns XrmServiceProvider.ProxyIds, the key set of a static registry the service tier fills from DataSources/DataSources.json at NavEnvironment construction. The runner's flattened artifact directory has no such file, so the registry stayed empty and the FindLast threw.
